dedupe_keys.name: lagos victoria island ikoyi lte drive test parameters

description: This dataset contains measured fourth-generation LTE network parameters from a vehicle drive test between Victoria Island and Ikoyi in Lagos, Nigeria. The research team installs an LTE modem and positioning receiver on a computer-equipped vehicle travelling at approximately thirty kilometres per hour. The article describes 42,498 one-second observations across seven base stations, supporting network planning and estimation of missing radio parameters. Mendeley supplies one CSV file free under CC BY 4.0. The brief repository description does not establish exact collection dates or complete operator and device coverage. A single drive route and campaign cannot represent all city coverage or long-term congestion. Missing-value predictions in the associated study also need to remain distinct from measured observations. A reviewer-assessed use is checking radio-quality and mobility assumptions in cellular-network simulations. platform-ns-3 is a related modelling environment, but no parameter conversion or propagation calibration was tested. No CSV or missing-data model was executed.
